items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Well, I never heard of this band.

ctx.x: Well, he should have been from the Seventh Ward. You know what they call the Seventh Ward? The what? They changed the word line so many times. No, no, no. You know what they call it around St. Bernard Avenue? They call that the Can't Tell Ward. Tell him. I don't still get it. Tell him. Along about St. Bernard Avenue, they call that the Can't Tell Ward, because you can't tell if they're white or colored. What about Paoletti's band? Who? Paoletti. Baoletti? Paoletti. Paoletti. Paoletti. Paoletti. Letty? Paoletti.…
Well, I played out there all the time. I had bands out there regular. You played at the West End? Well, I never heard of this band.

What about Almond Vesey? Never heard of him. Never heard of him. They may have been after your time, Papa. Must have been late bands. Must have been. Yeah. It couldn't have been around my time. Papa, let me ask you something. Did you ever go to any colored funeral marches when you were a child? No. Never did go to those colored funerals? No. No.
